title: Direct ordinary outputs can omit a varying program axis
observation: A two-axis (64,2,1) grid loads different row halves but both row_part programs store to the same mean and mean_square columns. The frozen Compiler accepts it; four of five original cases fail. Existing Metal and native backend checks own narrower instances of the same direct-coordinate hazard.
proposed_change: Make direct non-loop, non-persistent OUTPUT stores reject an omitted program axis with more than one tile in shared program safety. Preserve input-anchored coordinates, singleton axes and repeated uses. Keep state, loop and indirect-coordinate policies with their existing owners; migrate the duplicate Metal and native non-loop checks.
promotion_disposition: Proposed bounded safety coverage. No inference of full Task semantics, complete race freedom or performance.
